name: chmod-plus-x-single-file-is-not-gated
note: GUARD: `chmod +x script.sh` adds execute to one file — not recursive, not world-writable — so bash-chmod-dangerous does not fire. `chmod 644 f`, `chmod 755 f`, `chmod u+w f`, and `chmod g+w f` are guards too. Fails closed to gommage; it does NOT become an ask_picto for fs.chmod:dangerous.
